spec.explain: Toy illustration for arXiv 1412.6980: bars show first and second moments beside the Adam step, bounded by the valley condition.

questions.q: Predict how the step behaves if m is set to 0.8?
Many think a narrow valley must explode the step, but with v at 1.8 would you expect that?
What do you notice about scaling when v is set to 1.2?
Why does changing m to -0.6 keep the update bounded?
